aarti.pad1: The Gaṅgā flows at your feet,
aarti.pad2: Brahmā reads the Vedas daily at your door,
aarti.pad3: O Mother, the heart longs to see it again and again.
aarti.pad4: and the sound of bells rings out.
aarti.pad5: With betel leaf, areca nut, a flag, a coconut,
flowers and dried fruits as offerings,
your servants stand at your feet:
grant us your darśana, O Goddess.
aarti.pad6: Whoever comes to your door with a firm resolve,
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings all this praise day and night,
